title: TICKET-015-QS-01 — pipeline-quality-scorer.ts — per-video auto-scoring
rationale: Built scripts/scs001/pipeline-quality-scorer.ts: 5-dimension scoring (duration_ok 25pts, has_audio 20pts, has_subtitles 20pts, hook_timing 20pts, resolution_ok 15pts). Composite score < 60 → flagged. Logs to logs/pipeline-metrics/quality-scores.jsonl. Wired into batch-produce.ts after existing QC gates (line ~207): scoreVideo() called after runQCGates() passes, skip ledger write if score < 60. FFprobe-based scene detection for hook_timing check (first cut ≤3s). Compiles clean.
